overall_notes: This paper primarily investigates emergent abilities in LLMs through extensive evaluation of reasoning and question-answering tasks. The paper uses multiple automatic metrics and manual validation but does not employ LLM-as-judge evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but missed several tasks and model variants mentioned in the detailed experimental setup.
